answer: To enter, an identity locks 31 POA for nine epochs and names three established endorsers who do not share a custody cluster. Each endorser posts a lantern hash of the applicant's spend fingerprint mixed with the endorser's secret, then must return a delayed echo of that hash after a random two-to-five epoch wait, recorded on a public wharf log. If two applicants share an endorser in the same window, or an echo arrives in the wrong slot, two-thirds of the bond burns and the address freezes eight epochs: a farm of 400 aliases cannot recycle a small endorser set without lighting up the log.
